mapper.select: SELECT id, name, code, description, status, user_count, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM role WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT id, name, code, description, status, user_count, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM role WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT id, name, code, description, status, user_count, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM role WHERE code = #{code} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO role (name, code, description, status, user_count, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{code}, #{description}, #{status}, #{userCount}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
